name: pi-committer
description: Reliable conventional commit automation for the pi coding agent with immutable Git snapshots and race-safe background commits

scripts.check:runtime: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/config.mjs && node --check src/snapshot-engine.mjs && node --check src/message-engine.mjs && node --check src/worker.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:runtime && npm run test:reliability

author: pi-committer contributors
